title: Fasting and Quran as Intercessors
summary: Fasting and the Quran will intercede for believers on Judgment Day.
translation: Fasting is such an act of worship that it will intercede for the one who observed it in the presence of Allah in the Hereafter, and its intercession will be accepted. Similarly, the Holy Quran will intercede for those who recite it, and it will be granted acceptance. The Noble Prophet (peace be upon him) has said: 'Fasting and the Quran will intercede for the servant. Fasting will say: O Lord, I kept him from food and desires during the day, so accept my intercession for him. And the Quran will say: I kept him from sleep at night, so accept my intercession for him. Hence, both intercessions will be accepted.' This hadith indicates the importance of reciting the Quran, especially in Ramadan, and emphasizes listening to the Quran in Tarawih and maintaining the nightly prayers throughout the entire month.
